title: prefill-decode-chunked-speculative-stage-overlap-kernel-scheduler-kv-cache-optimizations
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: perf: Improve prefill vs decode pipeline overlap using chunked and speculative prefill, kernel scheduler heuristics, and KV-cache hot path optimizations. Expected improvements: +12-18% throughput, -5-9% p95 latency. Rollout gradual behind runtime flag.
description: Motivation: Prefill (encoder-like work) and decode stages currently execute largely serially which leaves GPU kernels underutilized for mixed workloads. This PR implements a set of coordinated optimizations to increase overlap between prefill and decode, reduce KV-cache contention, and improve kernel scheduling decisions so that continuous batching and chunked prefill workloads see measurable throughput and tail-latency gains. Summary of changes: 1) Chunked prefill path: break long prefill sequences into configurable chunks so KV-cache warmup and attention compute can start earlier for downstream decode tokens. 2) Speculative prefill: allow the runtime to speculatively execute prefill chunks when downstream decode backlog is likely, with safe rollback on mismatch. 3) Stage overlap scheduler: new scheduler heuristic that interleaves prefill and decode micro-batches based on sequence-length profiles and current KV-cache hit rates. 4) KV-cache hot-path optimizations: reduce atomic contention in the KV-store, add fast-path for single-GPU sessions, and introduce a compact pointer layout to improve memory locality. 5) Kernel scheduler hints: attach simple cost estimates to prefill/decoder kernels to prioritize shorter compute kernels and avoid large tensor stalls. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-1284) - [x] Microbench harness + unit tests - [x] End-to-end perf tests on p3/p4-equivalent nodes - [x] Feature flag gating and telemetry - [x] Rollout plan and rollback steps Performance: Microbench results (internal harness, 8x A100 equivalent): - Mixed chat workload (avg input 64 tokens, decode 128 tokens): throughput +14% token/sec, p95 latency -7% - Long-prefill workloads (input 1024 tokens): continuous batching throughput +18%, decode tail-latency unchanged or slightly better - Short-prefill high-concurrency (input 8 tokens): improvements ~9% due to reduced KV contention Safety and correctness: speculative prefill is conservative by default and requires a validation checkpoint before committing KV-cache state; falls back to non-speculative path when mismatch detected. Testing: added unit tests for KV-store layout, scheduler integration tests, and expanded continuous batching CI job with synthetic traffic profiles. Files changed: runtime/scheduler/*, runtime/kv_cache/*, runtime/prefill/*, tests/perf/*, docs/designs/prefill-decode-overlap.md. Rollout: behind runtime.feature.prefill_decode_overlap flag; can be enabled per-customer. Gradual rollout to Dedicated and Hosted: 10% -> 50% -> 100% with perf dashboards monitored. Notes: there is a small memory-pressure increase for very long-context sessions due to chunk bookkeeping; we've added a telemetry counter to track this. Diffs are limited to runtime hot paths; no API surface changes.

review_comments: Carlos Mendes (Reviewer): Overall looks promising. Two concerns: 1) memory overhead for chunk bookkeeping with long contexts, please add metrics and an opt-out; 2) speculative prefill rollback path needs a clear invariant so we don't leak KV state. Please add tests for the rollback on mismatch.

Aisha Patel (Author): Addressed both. Added telemetry counters (prefill_chunk_memory_bytes) and an opt-out config. Added unit test 'speculative_prefill_rollback_test' that simulates mismatch and verifies KV-store unchanged. See commits c7e1a43 and i9d4e55.
Emily Zhao (Reviewer): Can you quantify perf on p3 vs p4? Also please ensure sched config is runtime-tunable (not compile-time).
Aisha Patel: Microbench added for both p3 and p4-equivalent nodes; results in description. Scheduler config toggles are runtime flags (see kernel_scheduler.h).
Ryan O'Neill (Reviewer): Liked the kernel cost annotations. Two nit: prefer smaller default chunk size and clearer docs for per-customer rollout steps.
Aisha Patel: Default chunk size reduced to 64 tokens after perf runs. Added rollout steps to docs/designs/prefill-decode-overlap.md and release notes.

Commit message: 'perf(prefill/decode): chunked + speculative prefill, stage overlap scheduler, KV-cache hotpath optimizations (ENG-1284, ENG-1320)'. Rollout gated by runtime.feature.prefill_decode_overlap. Observability: prefill_chunk_count and spec_prefill_rollbacks added to metrics registry.
notes: This change required coordinated tuning across kernel selection and KV-cache layout. We validated on internal Dedicated clusters. No public API changes. Monitor metrics: prefill_chunk_count, spec_prefill_rollbacks, prefill_chunk_memory_bytes.
